task_specification.objective: Make the current authored candidate closure-ready on all three host-selected release surfaces: isolate each physical input activation to one context, deterministically balance the preserved Mossling variants in representative combat, and seal the ordinary seven-to-ten-minute five-wave run through truthful results, clean replay, and inspectable provenance.

diagnosis.root_cause: Settings Back synthesizes ui_cancel and synchronously exposes the Title menu while that same physical activation is still propagating; the preserved Title menu can therefore interpret it as a second cancellation and open Exit Game. Mossling selection hashes stable id together with spawn generation, whose parity correlates with the representative roster and yields a deterministic 10/3 split instead of a role-local balanced sequence. The complete-run systems exist, but the ordinary five-wave route, build diversity, immutable result summary, lifecycle reset, and aggregate release provenance are not yet sealed as one candidate-verifiable release contract; prior evidence used prepared states rather than an uninterrupted ordinary victory route.

stop_conditions: Stop without editing the deferred Warden animation-binding or camera-occlusion surfaces; they remain outside this iteration.
Stop and escalate if the input repair would require modifying or replacing the preserved Maaack package instead of isolating the handoff in product-owned routing code.
Stop and escalate before replacing, splitting, or performing source surgery on the accepted cemetery, enemy GLB, menu, font, weapon, or audio packages.
Stop implementation after focused candidate checks pass; native recapture, formal issue closure, and phase closure remain Host and Tester responsibilities.

strategy.rationale: Use three independent root-cause treatments: a release-gated page handoff for input, role-local deterministic allocation for visual variants, and an authoritative ordinary-route/release manifest pass. This preserves accepted presentation and gameplay ownership while giving Tester direct black-box and white-box retest paths.

code: Run the native project/import and host boot checks; require no fatal parse, resource-load, missing-binding, or recurring runtime errors.
Inspect InputMap and routing state to confirm physical controls map only through the contextual router and all synthesized actions are released after handoffs.
Check deterministic variant allocation and reset logic against role counts from the exact 32-enemy roster, including a maximum per-role share of 75%.
Validate five aligned wave definitions, ordinary-route guards, immutable terminal fields, clean teardown invariants, and provenance coverage for every bound external receipt.

Tester plays an uninterrupted ordinary seven-to-ten-minute victory run and separate failure route, exercising Lantern-, Gravespade-, and Wisps-centered choices without validation preparation.
Tester performs Retry and Return-to-Title after both terminal outcomes for three cycles, comparing actors, attacks, registries, audio voices, pause state, focus, and baseline counts.

Capture separated ordinary-camera views of both Mossling variants plus representative dense combat showing both variants of all four ordinary roles.

Record originating context generation, activation generation, release observation, resolved destination, and downstream-action count so Tester can prove exactly one committed action.
